title: Greetings & Introductions

scenes.t: {name} goes to school. Two girls, Sara and Lina, meet in the playground.
Sara says: Hello! Lina says: Good morning!
Sara: How are you? Lina: I am fine, thank you. How are you? Sara: I'm fine too, thank you.
Sara: What's your name? Lina: My name is Lina. What's your name? Sara: My name is Sara.
Lina: How old are you? Sara: I am 8 years old! I am in Primary 3.
Lina: Nice to meet you, Sara! Sara: Nice to meet you too, Lina!
Lina: See you later! Sara: Goodbye! Now it is your turn: say hello to a new friend!

items.a: We say it when we meet someone.
We say it when we meet someone in the morning.
We ask it when we check on someone.
We say it when we meet someone new.
We say it when we will see the person again.
We say it when we leave.
We use it to introduce ourselves.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match each phrase with when we use it.
pairs: when you meet in the morning

activities.title: Hello or Goodbye?
activities.prompt: Do we say it when we MEET or when we LEAVE?

why.m: We say it at the start.
why.l: We say it at the end.
